entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.9
entry.summary: New: FAKE5 for Linux - VST3, LV2 and a standalone app (64-bit, built on Ubuntu 22.04). Checked with pluginval like the Windows version.

entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.8
entry.summary: The window opens as large as you left it - also after closing and reopening the DAW (before, it came back at the smallest size). A new instance starts at the size you used last. Saving your own sounds fixed: the save window now opens inside the plugin (before, it could open hidden behind the DAW's plugin window, so nothing got saved). If Windows keeps apps out of the Documents folder, your sounds are saved in AppData instead. A failed save now says so.

entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.7
entry.summary: A Take-5-style 5- or 10-voice poly: two oscillators with continuous shape, sub, noise, sync and linear FM 2>1, a driven 4-pole low-pass, two DADSR envelopes, two LFOs, sixteen mod slots on a display page, vintage, overdrive, voice spread, twelve effects and a plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.3
